board: Vermont Board of Public Accountancy (Office of Professional Regulation)

cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Vermont licenses renew July 31 of odd-numbered years: 80 hours over the two years, including 4 of ethics and 8 of accounting and auditing. Up to 10 extra hours carry forward.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each two-year period (Rule 9.1). Up to 10 hours over the 80 carry into the next period, toward the 80 only (not ethics or A&A).

requirements.label: Accounting & auditing
requirements.note: All licensees: at least 8 hours of accounting and auditing each period (Rule 9.1(f)).

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 4 hours of ethics for accountants each period (Rule 9.1(e)).

byIssueYearInPeriod.note: Licensed in the first year of this period: 40 hours for the full year licensed, including 4 ethics and 8 accounting & auditing (Rule 9.1(b)).
Licensed less than a year before renewal: no general hours, but the 4 ethics and 8 accounting & auditing hours still apply (OPR renewal instructions).

licenseDateHint: Vermont licenses expire July 31 of odd-numbered years (e.g. 07/31/2027).
issueDateHint: New licensees: 40 hours for each full year licensed in the period.
limitsNotTracked: Instructor credit: max 50%; published articles and books: max 25%.
Only whole hours count (50 minutes = 1 hour).
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for 5 years after each program (Rule 9.3(b)).
toVerify: Licensed less than a year before renewal: 4 ethics and 8 A&A per OPR's renewal instructions.
